productTruth: YNX Card is a future real virtual-card product; this contract permits only Testnet YNXT funding and simulated authorization, capture, reversal and refund. It is not a real card network, fiat flow, merchant payment, PAN or CVV service.

canonicalFunding.intentAuthority: Card service issues an exact, short-lived funding intent after accepted Wallet connection.
canonicalFunding.recipientRule: No client, callback or UI may invent, substitute or cache a recipient. A recipient becomes callable only when the Card runtime publishes an exact signed intent through an accepted endpoint manifest.

authoritativeFlow: User Wallet submits the exact YNXT Testnet transaction
verify chainId, sender, recipient, amount, transaction hash, receipt status, block and required confirmations
deduplicate by finalized transaction hash plus canonical funding intent
emit card.funded only after finalized authoritative proof
publish the privacy-safe Data Fabric Outbox event
credit the immutable Card Ledger only after reconciliation state is matched
rejectionRules: wrong chain, recipient, sender, amount or expired intent
missing Data Fabric event or unmatched ledger reconciliation

cardCandidate.tests: 19/19 passed and TypeScript typecheck passed locally on 2026-08-20

rollback: Reject the intent and leave Card available balance unchanged; append only compensating reversal/reconciliation records, never mutate a historical ledger entry.
